decision.title: 7 Powers: The Foundations of Business Strategy
decision.author: Hamilton Helmer
decision.imprint: Deep Strategy primary 2016 English edition family

rationale: Google Books identifies the core 2016 Deep Strategy edition family and supplies the canonical title, author, year, and official description.

The SellingSherpa chapter map and multiple secondary summaries align on the same nine numbered chapters after the introduction-level setup, with no competing translation or materially different chapter order surfacing.
No edition ambiguity surfaced that would materially change chapter interpretation, so the pack's auto-lock rule applies and no user question is required.
